rationale: The four views are mutually coherent and show no visible solid collisions. A broad podium with an offset upper block is legible, but the upper mass reads as a shallow slab rather than a distinctly slender tower, weakening the stated dominant gesture. The form avoids a heavily stair-stepped silhouette, though its stepback logic is only lightly expressed. There is no meaningful courtyard, undercut, or open-ground void. The clean, simple solids suggest strong repair integrity, while resonance with the references is limited because the candidate lacks their stronger vertical anchor, torque, terrace, or undercut principles.
warnings: The upper mass is too low and broad to read convincingly as a slender tower.
The massing currently provides little meaningful public void or undercroft logic.
The podium-to-upper relationship is clear but not yet distinctive enough to carry the dominant gesture.
